# The Institute for Functional Medicine

> The Institute for Functional Medicine (IFM) is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing functional medicine education, certification, and research to transform healthcare through root-cause treatment and personalized care.

IFM provides professional certification, clinical training, patient resources, and advocacy for practitioners and patients seeking a systems-based approach to chronic disease prevention and treatment. The organization supports healthcare transformation through evidence-based functional medicine research, educational programs, and a global practitioner network.

## Key Topics

- Functional Medicine
- Healthcare Transformation
- Clinical Certification
- Personalized Care
- Chronic Disease Prevention

## Core Functional Medicine

- [Home](https://www.ifm.org): IFM homepage featuring functional medicine overview, programs, and certification
- [What is Functional Medicine?](https://www.ifm.org/functional-medicine): Functional medicine overview, root-cause treatment, and holistic approach
- [Health Topics](https://www.ifm.org/health-topics): Functional medicine health topics library and clinical framework guide
- [Functional Medicine in Practice](https://www.ifm.org/functional-medicine/in-practice): Functional medicine clinical practice models and practitioner benefits
- [Adrenal, Thyroid, & Pituitary Health](https://www.ifm.org/adrenal-thyroid-pituitary-health): Functional medicine approach to hormone balance and endocrine health
- [Bone, Skin, & Muscle Health](https://www.ifm.org/bone-skin-muscle-health): Functional medicine guide to musculoskeletal and integumentary health
